summary: Residential kerb near the street's west end; cars park here, homes within 20-30 m.

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 19 m (houses across the road) and 27 m (Kings Place flats); homes on all sides.

drivers.traffic: Quiet local street near a side-street junction; light traffic.
